steps.name: note-public-v0-2-2-gsm-first-use-blocker
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1
DIR="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-release022-note-XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$DIR"' EXIT
gh release view v0.2.2 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --json body --jq .body > "$DIR/original"
cat > "$DIR/new" <<'EOF'
**KNOWN MVP BLOCKER (2026-11-23):** v0.2.2 cannot self-pair Wireless ADB or start the production GSM host because that path was restricted to the separate test package. Do not use this APK for GSM calling. A corrected 0.2.3 build is undergoing clean-device acceptance before public release.

---

EOF
cat "$DIR/original" >> "$DIR/new"
gh release edit v0.2.2 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --notes-file "$DIR/new" --prerelease
gh release view v0.2.2 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --json body --jq .body | grep -q 'KNOWN MVP BLOCKER'
echo "OLD_RELEASE_BLOCKER_DISCLOSED=true"
